turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Dr. Mehta speaking. I have about five minutes. What is this about?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Namaste Doctor sahab, main Anjali, ClinicDesk se. Ek minute, aapke clinic mein appointments kaise book hote hain abhi?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Phone pe. Receptionist diary mein likhti hai.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Achha. Aur patients time pe aate hain?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sab nahi. Kaafi log nahi aate. Chauthai toh aate hi nahi.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ye toh loss hai. ClinicDesk WhatsApp pe reminder bhejta hai, ek din pehle aur do ghante pehle. Isse no-shows kam hote hain generally.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Mere patients zyada tar buzurg hain. App nahi chalayenge.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Koi app nahi hai sir. Sab WhatsApp pe hota hai. Wo bas message ka reply karte hain.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Chaudah sau ninyanave rupaye mahina. Aur chaudah din ka free trial hai.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Samajh sakti hoon sir. Trial mein aap khud dekh lijiye, koi commitment nahi hai.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Theek hai sir, aap soch lijiye. Main baad mein call karti hoon. Thank you.
